content.value: A single-threaded 25 mm power screw is 25 mm in diameter with a pitch of 5 mm. A vertical load on the screw reaches a maximum of 5 kN. The coefficient of friction are 0.06 for the collar and 0.09 for the threads. The frictional diameter of the collar is 45 mm. Find the overall efficiency and the torque to “raise" and “lower"the load.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2021
